visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium Check: This sequence begins with a graphic-based animation. A close-up shot of the EVA-13 figure's head is presented against a purple-to-blue gradient background. The robot features a menacing, open-mouthed expression with red teeth and eyes, and various mechanical parts in silver, purple, and black. Bold, neon-green text overlays in Traditional Chinese and Japanese flash across the center of the frame, accompanied by the creator's logo at the top right corner. The lighting is stylized with vibrant, unnatural colors. (2) The scene shifts to a real-world setting in a brightly lit studio. A large, rectangular cardboard box featuring highly detailed artwork of the Evangelion unit is shown on a light-colored wooden table. The hands of a male creator, wearing a white t-shirt and a black baseball cap, enter the frame to begin the unboxing process. He removes the outer sleeve and reveals the inner white styrofoam protection, which is secured with clear adhesive tape. (3) The creator uses a silver hobby knife to precisely slice through the tape on the styrofoam lid. He lifts the top cover to reveal numerous figure components, each individually wrapped in clear plastic bags or protective bubble wrap. The camera uses a high-angle shot to capture the organized layout of the parts. The studio lighting is even and bright, casting soft shadows on the workspace. (4) The assembly phase begins with the placement of a heavy, grey resin base onto the table. The base depicts a ruined urban scene with a pool of red liquid and a defeated robotic torso. The creator's hands are seen delicately attaching small antenna-like protrusions to the head of the main figure. The purple torso, which features four arms and intricate silver joints, is highlighted through a series of fast-paced jump cuts. (5) Final phase showcases the completed model in a dramatic reveal. The EVA-13 figure stands fully assembled on its base, towering over the destroyed city elements and holding two massive, crimson-colored Spears of Longinus. Digital post-production effects, including floating sparkles and light flares, are added to enhance the visual appeal. The camera performs slow pans and zooms to detail the metallic paint job and the complex sculpt of the spears and mechanical wings.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio experience begins with an upbeat, high-energy hip-hop and trap-infused track. The background music features a prominent, punchy kick drum and a rhythmic, sub-heavy bassline that establishes a fast-paced tempo. A male voice provides background vocals in a mix of English and Korean. The mix is professionally produced with a clear, bright spectral balance and high acoustic dynamism. (2) A sharp "mechanical click" SFX triggers a new phase as the cutter slices through the tape, followed immediately by the "rustle of plastic" bags. These sound effects are crisp and high-frequency, suggesting a clean field recording environment or well-placed Foley. The background music continues without interruption, maintaining its high volume and strong beat strength of approximately 95 beats per minute. (3) A "percussive thud" sounds as the heavy resin base is set down on the wooden work surface. The audio lacks any primary human speech or narration, focusing instead on the interplay between the intense music and the incidental noises of handling the model. The ambient noise floor is extremely low, typical of a studio setting or a post-produced track where room tone has been minimized. (4) A "high-pitched digital whoosh" effect marks a visual transition into the assembly detail shots. This intentional post-production sound effect adds a layer of professionalism to the edit. More "plastic clicks" and "metallic thuds" are heard as the creator plugs arms and weapons into the torso. These transients are sharp and exhibit short spectral bandwidth, cutting through the dense musical arrangement. (5) The video concludes with the music maintaining its intensity through the final reveal. There is a "synthesized stinger" sound effect that punctuates the final graphic. The overall harmonic tension remains moderate, as the track relies on a consistent minor-mode loop. The production style is polished and compressed, ensuring that the sound effects and the background music are balanced.
